description: Report everything recorded about one crawled URL: status code, redirect target, title and meta description, Open Graph tags, word count, link and asset counts, headings, TTFB, Web Vitals score, and the full issue list for that page. Use it after query_issues or issues_summary when you need the context behind a specific page's issues. It never returns the page's HTML source; to inspect markup, fetch the URL yourself.

session_id.description: Crawl session id from list_crawls. Omit to use the most recent crawl.

url.description: The exact page URL as it appears in the crawl, including the scheme.

name: page_report
